All human beings are born free and equal in dignity and rights.
They are endowed with reason and conscience
  and should act towards one another in a spirit of brotherhood.

A paragraph introducing a list of items:
  the first item in the list;
  the second item in the list;
  and the final item of that list.
Followed by a closing sentence.

- A list item with a sentence in it.
    a pinned continuation of that item.

> A quoted sentence that is long enough.
>   a pinned continuation inside the quote.

A paragraph with a hard break at the end of this line.\
  a pinned continuation after the hard break.

Indentation is binary rather than a depth:
  a continuation written at one level,
  and one the author wrote at two, which lands on the same level.
Back at the top level again.

A continuation whose previous line carries no clause punctuation at all
  still counts, because indentation is the signal rather than the punctuation.

- A list item, three levels down:
  - a second level,
    - a third level introducing something:
        a pinned continuation at the deepest level.

> - A list inside a block quote:
>     a pinned continuation there too.
